import HartshorneLib.Chapter4RegularDifferentialSections

/-!
# The sheaf of regular rational differentials

The modules of rational differentials regular on an open form a presheaf.  A
chosen nonzero rational differential identifies this presheaf with the divisor
presheaf of its differential divisor, so the sheaf condition is inherited from
the bounded-rational-function construction.  The resulting sheaf itself does
not depend on that choice.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry Opposite

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]

open Classical in
noncomputable def regularDifferentialSectionsRes
    {U V : X.left.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) :
    regularDifferentialSections X U →ₗ[k] regularDifferentialSections X V :=
  if hV : (V : Set X.left).Nonempty then
    Submodule.inclusion (regularDifferentialSections_antitone X h hV)
  else 0

lemma regularDifferentialSectionsRes_coe
    {U V : X.left.Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
    (hV : (V : Set X.left).Nonempty)
    (s : regularDifferentialSections X U) :
    ((regularDifferentialSectionsRes X h s : regularDifferentialSections X V) :
        CurveRationalDifferentials X) = (s : CurveRationalDifferentials X) := by
  classical
  rw [regularDifferentialSectionsRes, dif_pos hV, Submodule.coe_inclusion]

lemma regularDifferentialSectionsRes_id
    {U : X.left.Opens} (h : U ≤ U) :
    regularDifferentialSectionsRes X h = LinearMap.id := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro s
  by_cases hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty
  · exact Subtype.ext (regularDifferentialSectionsRes_coe X h hU s)
  · letI := regularDifferentialSections_subsingleton_of_empty X hU
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

lemma regularDifferentialSectionsRes_comp
    {U V W : X.left.Opens} (hWV : W ≤ V) (hVU : V ≤ U) :
    regularDifferentialSectionsRes X (le_trans hWV hVU) =
      (regularDifferentialSectionsRes X hWV).comp
        (regularDifferentialSectionsRes X hVU) := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro s
  by_cases hW : (W : Set X.left).Nonempty
  · have hV : (V : Set X.left).Nonempty := hW.mono hWV
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply,
      regularDifferentialSectionsRes_coe X (le_trans hWV hVU) hW,
      regularDifferentialSectionsRes_coe X hWV hW,
      regularDifferentialSectionsRes_coe X hVU hV]
  · letI := regularDifferentialSections_subsingleton_of_empty X hW
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

noncomputable def regularDifferentialPresheaf :
    (X.left.Opens)ᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k where
  obj U := ModuleCat.of k (regularDifferentialSections X U.unop)
  map {U V} i := ModuleCat.ofHom
    (regularDifferentialSectionsRes X (leOfHom i.unop))
  map_id U := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    simp only [ModuleCat.hom_ofHom, ModuleCat.hom_id,
      regularDifferentialSectionsRes_id X (leOfHom (𝟙 U.unop))]
  map_comp {U V W} i j := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    have hcomp : regularDifferentialSectionsRes X (leOfHom (i ≫ j).unop) =
        (regularDifferentialSectionsRes X (leOfHom j.unop)).comp
          (regularDifferentialSectionsRes X (leOfHom i.unop)) :=
      regularDifferentialSectionsRes_comp X (leOfHom j.unop) (leOfHom i.unop)
    simp only [ModuleCat.hom_ofHom, ModuleCat.hom_comp, hcomp]

variable [IsAlgClosed k] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]

noncomputable def regularDifferentialPresheafIso
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) :
    divisorPresheaf (differentialDivisor X ω hω) ≅
      regularDifferentialPresheaf X :=
  NatIso.ofComponents
    (fun U =>
      LinearEquiv.toModuleIso
        (divisorSectionsRegularDifferentialsEquiv X ω hω U.unop))
    (by
      intro U V i
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro s
      let s' : divisorSections (differentialDivisor X ω hω) U.unop := s
      by_cases hV : (V.unop : Set X.left).Nonempty
      · apply Subtype.ext
        change ((divisorSectionsRegularDifferentialsEquiv X ω hω V.unop)
            (divisorSectionsRes (differentialDivisor X ω hω) (leOfHom i.unop) s') :
              CurveRationalDifferentials X) =
          (regularDifferentialSectionsRes X (leOfHom i.unop)
            ((divisorSectionsRegularDifferentialsEquiv X ω hω U.unop) s') :
              CurveRationalDifferentials X)
        rw [regularDifferentialSectionsRes_coe X (leOfHom i.unop) hV,
          divisorSectionsRegularDifferentialsEquiv_coe X ω hω,
          divisorSectionsRes_coe (D := differentialDivisor X ω hω)
            (leOfHom i.unop) hV s',
          divisorSectionsRegularDifferentialsEquiv_coe X ω hω]
      · letI := regularDifferentialSections_subsingleton_of_empty X hV
        letI := divisorPresheaf_obj_subsingleton
          (D := differentialDivisor X ω hω) (W := V.unop) hV
        dsimp [regularDifferentialPresheaf]
        exact Subsingleton.elim _ _)

lemma isSheaf_regularDifferentialPresheaf :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat))
      (regularDifferentialPresheaf X) := by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ := exists_nonzero_curveRationalDifferential X
  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_of_iso_iff (regularDifferentialPresheafIso X ω hω).symm]
  exact isSheaf_divisorPresheaf (differentialDivisor X ω hω)

/-- The sheaf of rational differentials regular on each open.

Its construction uses only the intrinsic local differential lattices; a
nonzero rational differential is used only in the proof of the sheaf axiom.
-/
noncomputable def regularDifferentialSheaf :
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat))
      (ModuleCat.{u} k) :=
  ⟨regularDifferentialPresheaf X, isSheaf_regularDifferentialPresheaf X⟩

@[simp] lemma regularDifferentialSheaf_obj (U : X.left.Opens) :
    (regularDifferentialSheaf X).obj.obj (op U) =
      ModuleCat.of k (regularDifferentialSections X U) := rfl

/-- Multiplication by a selected rational differential identifies its divisor
sheaf with the independently constructed regular-differential sheaf. -/
noncomputable def regularDifferentialSheafIso
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) :
    divisorSheaf (differentialDivisor X ω hω) ≅ regularDifferentialSheaf X :=
  (fullyFaithfulSheafToPresheaf _ _).preimageIso
    (regularDifferentialPresheafIso X ω hω)

@[simp] lemma regularDifferentialSheafIso_hom_app_coe
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) (U : X.left.Opens)
    (f : divisorSections (differentialDivisor X ω hω) U) :
    Subtype.val (show regularDifferentialSections X U from
      (regularDifferentialSheafIso X ω hω).hom.hom.app (op U) f) =
      (f : X.left.functionField) • ω := rfl

end
end Hartshorne
